towards.en: Today, that number is zero. And many countries, especially in Europe, have gone a similar route: initial excitement in the post-war period about this "new" and revolutionary technology, and then a turn towards protest and opposition.
towards.zh: 如今，这一数字为零。许多国家，尤其是欧洲国家，都走过了一条相似的道路：战后初期对这项“全新”且具有革命性的技术充满热情，随后转向抗议和反对。

tone.en: Even in countries that haven't reversed course entirely, the tone has changed.
tone.zh: 即使在没有彻底掉头的国家，基调也变了。

tone.en: In Finland, the Green party voted back in 2022 to formally support nuclear power as part of its climate strategy, and the tone has started to change in several other countries too.
tone.zh: 早在2022年，芬兰绿党就投票正式支持将核能作为其气候战略的一部分，其他几个国家的态度也开始发生转变。

tool.en: In many countries, nuclear power has become a non-partisan issue: something those on the right and the left agree on, and even something that some Green parties have started to come round to as an important tool in the fight against climate change.
tool.zh: 在许多国家，核电已经成为一个跨党派议题：左右翼都能达成共识，甚至连一些绿党也开始转而接受它，认为它是应对气候变化的重要工具。

top.en: It means that within a few years, the amount of power these buildings need could be more than double what it is today, on top of everything else the grid has to supply.
top.zh: 这意味着在短短几年内，这些建筑所需的电量可能会比现在翻上一倍多，而这还没算电网必须供应的其他一切用电。

tomato.en: For breakfast, you can try full English breakfasts: eggs, bacon, sausages, beans, mushrooms, tomatoes, and toast, sometimes black pudding as well.
tomato.zh: 早餐方面，你可以尝试英式全套早餐：鸡蛋、培根、香肠、焗豆、蘑菇、西红柿和吐司，有时还有黑布丁。
